title: RailRoute AI Phase 3 - train-change connection engine: delivery report
route_scenario: MYS -> DWR (the product scenario, used for the synthetic test network)
live_api_test_policy: tests/test_live_train_change.py is skipped by default (pytest marker live_api); runs only with RUN_LIVE_API_TESTS=1 and a configured RAILCORE_API_KEY, with a <=6-request budget
development_verification: entirely against httpx.MockTransport with synthetic 998xx trains; production flow contains no mock data; provider integration untouched
algorithm: time-dependent earliest-arrival (connection-scan style) BFS over a schedule-derived leg graph; chronological event heap; no fixed maximum number of train changes; cycle prevention via station visited-sets; no dominance pruning (no valid journey discarded for having more changes); lazy, budget-capped, schedule-anchored station-pair discovery (no blind pair enumeration)
required_scenarios_covered: 6 second train not stopping at the interchange
7 overnight connection crossing midnight (per-segment boarding dates)
15 query-budget exhaustion before any availability request (requests + credits)
19 more than two train changes (three changes)
20 unverified segment never recommended as fully available
booking_status_never_used: BOOKING_CONFIRMED (the system does not book tickets)
phase_4_notes: Both engines emit self-contained journey objects (journey_type SAME_TRAIN_SEGMENTS vs TRAIN_CHANGE, per-segment statuses/fares/timestamps, explicit TRAIN_CHANGE transfer blocks) designed for the phase 4 mixed-journey combiner
